component.name: Thulium
component.summary: Fast, lightweight, and cross-platform raster image editor

description.p: Thulium is a fast, lightweight, and cross-platform raster image editor written in native C++17 with Qt 6 and a hardware-accelerated Vulkan rendering pipeline.

ul.li: Native reader and writer for the Paint.NET (.pdn / PDN3) document format alongside standard formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF).
Hardware-accelerated Vulkan backend for real-time viewport transformations, pan, zoom, and blitting with optimized CPU fallback.
Non-destructive multi-layer composition with opacity controls and blend modes.
Comprehensive toolset: Brush, Pencil, Eraser, Fill Bucket, Shapes, Text, Color Picker, and Selection tools.
Built-in adjustments and effects: Brightness/Contrast, Gaussian Blur, Hue/Saturation, Invert, and more.
Full undo/redo history stack and multi-document tabbed workspace.
